answer: Each agent identity requires a zero-knowledge attestation of a TPM/SGX enclave, with the hollow state tree binding code, nonce, and owner key to a pulse hash anchor; the canyon consensus contract accepts only fresh proofs and a quadratic bonding curve O(N^2).
